news.title: Arrest made in Piedmont Park 404 Day shooting
news.summary: Atlanta PD said an arrest has been made in the shooting death of a teen on 404 Day.

news.title: 17-year-old suspect surrenders in deadly '404 Day' shooting, APD says
news.summary: 17-year-old Kaine Burnette self-surrendered to the Fulton County Jail on charges related to the Apr. 4 homicide.

news.title: Raccoon tests positive for rabies after attacking metro Atlanta resident
news.summary: A raccoon that attacked and bit a person in the Sandy Springs/Dunwoody area has tested positive for rabies, the Fulton County Health Department and Fulton County Police Department announced on Friday.

news.title: Police search for suspects in southeast Atlanta car break-in
news.summary: Atlanta police are asking for the public's help to identify two suspects caught on camera allegedly using a credit card stolen from a vehicle in southeast Atlanta earlier this week.

news.title: How repeated burglaries left a Grant Park business owner facing $30K in losses
news.summary: A Grant Park smoke shop owner faces over $33,000 in total damages and stolen goods following two separate break-in incidents.

news.title: Former contractor banned from all Fulton County Schools, accused of theft
news.summary: Police arrested Jason Johnson at Cambridge High School after investigating thefts across multiple Fulton County campuses.

news.title: Man facing criminal charges after chucking a drink at Dairy Queen drive-thru worker in Cobb County
news.summary: "It’s okay to ask for a manager. It’s okay to request your order be fixed. It’s never okay to assault someone who is simply doing their job," police said.

news.title: Rockdale deputies searching for missing 14-year-old girl
news.summary: The Rockdale County Sheriff's Office is asking for the public's help in locating a 14-year-old girl who has been reported missing and is believed to have run away.
